source: mistake-retro at 84b9f19; harvest from lead transcript, 235 subagent transcripts, repo records

classes.title: Value or model hand-copied with no generated or golden link to Lean
classes.rootCause: Ports and docs restated original values by hand. Golden vectors covered only logic.ts, so static CSS (colours, fonts, heights, display, page order) had no Lean source, and a wrong copy type-checks and passes every check that exists.

hardening.enforcedBy: fw lint in check.sh and fw land: an uncovered probe fails; static values emitted by Lean as CSS constants, TS checked against goldens

classes.title: Docstring math with no mechanical link to the Lean statement
classes.rootCause: LaTeX was written by hand after the proof. Lints arrived one per review round (quantifier, shadow, where), so each round found the next pattern; nothing compared the binders of the math with the binders of the term.
existingLean: lean/MathView.lean:169 mathHash (docstring-only edits mark reviews stale)

hardening.enforcedBy: mathview --lint on the changed declarations in the pre-push hook (not only in CI); error, not warning

classes.title: Claim given a status (or a number) it had not earned
classes.rootCause: Status words CONFIRMED/MEASURED and numeric bounds are free text. Nothing ties CONFIRMED to a source citation, MEASURED to a run id, or a stated bound to a theorem, so a guess reads like a result.

hardening.enforcedBy: fw lint over research/notes and docs/plan/PLAN.md (pre-commit); a claim without its kind of reference fails

classes.title: Plan or schedule not checked against the standing user principles
classes.rootCause: Principles (ASAP graph, Lean first, measure on CI, prove not phone-measure, every breakpoint) lived in memory and CLAUDE.md prose; the work graph had no lint that encodes them, so the lead's ordering choices could violate them silently.
existingLean: lean/Fw/Site/BreakpointMatrix.lean (every breakpoint, after the user stated it)

hardening.enforcedBy: fw plan lint (work-graph fields kind/lane/leanModule) and fw next ranking by critical path

classes.title: Success signal that does not entail the verdict
classes.rootCause: The only machine-read signals were exit codes and job conclusions; the real verdict (summary.json rollup, which flags ran, which scope, test exit) lived in files no gate read. The gate summary still exits 0 when parts fail.

hardening.enforcedBy: cli.mjs summary exits non-zero from the Lean verdict; fw land and fw next refuse a port/variant handback without a matching verdict record

classes.title: Measurement validity precondition left implicit
classes.rootCause: The harness assumed samples were settled, aligned, on one clock and in one unit; the Lean models took samples as given, so a sample that broke the assumption became a verdict instead of a refusal.

hardening.enforcedBy: sample records carry settle/key/clock/unit fields; Lean refuses with the failed precondition named; goldens from the real misreads

classes.title: Shared file, branch or directory with no ownership or lock contract
classes.rootCause: Admission checked write-write overlap only; reads of shared contracts, hand-kept registration files, the main branch during a land, and scratch names had no owner, so parallel work collided.

hardening.statementLatex: \forall t \neq u \in \mathrm{Run},\ W_t \cap (W_u \cup R_u) = \emptyset; \quad \mathrm{scratch}(a,f) = \mathrm{scratch}(a',f') \Rightarrow a = a' \land f = f'
hardening.enforcedBy: work-graph tasks gain reads; spawn admission refuses overlap; registration files generated (land-hardening check-imports)

classes.title: Cheap static check absent, or run only after the commit
classes.rootCause: node --check, zod, plan lint, mathview lint and YAML parse existed or were trivial, but ran in CI or at land, never on the changed files before the commit; no map said which check covers which path.

hardening.enforcedBy: Lean generates the glob->check table; pre-commit hook runs checks(changed); fw lint fails on an unmapped tracked path

classes.title: Wait or child process with no bound and no owner
classes.rootCause: Subagents had no sanctioned blocking wait, so they wrote shell loops; nothing required a deadline, a reachable predicate or an owner PID group, and nothing reported a child that never ended.

hardening.enforcedBy: PreToolUse(Bash) refuses until/while without a deadline and backgrounded stdin readers; obs-signals flags open background tasks at handback

classes.title: Shared capacity consumed with no admission budget
classes.rootCause: Shared pools (GitHub token, 5 macOS slots, 20-job cap, Mac CPU and disk, agent cap, prompt-cache TTL, context) had no budget at the point of use; each agent optimised locally.

hardening.enforcedBy: Lean generates runs-on, concurrency groups and paths filters; a workflow lint compares; fw next emits stop/respawn by the resume rule

classes.title: Authority or identity decided by a text or name heuristic
classes.rootCause: Who-is-who (lead vs fork, which process is a build, who owns a loop, which agent type) was inferred from argv text, empty fields or names instead of a recorded id fact, so a heuristic both over-granted and over-refused.

hardening.enforcedBy: decisions take (agent_id, role, capability, pid-record) only; goldens with the same ids but different argv text; /api/commands actor from capability

classes.title: State stored, or derived from event order or a naming convention, instead of from facts
classes.rootCause: Board, health and land state were partly written by hand (trailers, title prefixes, line:col ids, retention timers) or depended on which event came first, so the same facts in another order gave another state.

hardening.enforcedBy: every board/health field a fold over facts; goldens replay the real traces in shuffled order

classes.title: Unverified assumption about a tool, platform or environment
classes.rootCause: The agent acted on a belief about a tool (flag, reload, cache, shell dialect, lemma name, runtime) without a cheap probe first; most of these are outside any pure model.
existingLean: none (I/O); lean/Fw/Ops/SpawnGuard.lean:503 isolation_not_mismatch covers role substitution only

hardening.enforcedBy: golden argv table for every repo CLI; for external tools the empirical probe named per mistake
hardening.task: NEW check-map-lean (CLI argv golden); rest empirical

classes.title: Instruction under-specified or not checked against the deliverable
classes.rootCause: Spawn prompts and task specs were not checked against what the task must deliver (handoff, files, tools), and human-channel instructions were long and asynchronous.

hardening.enforcedBy: fw plan lint and spawn-guard check the spec; fw land refuses without the handoff file

classes.title: Safety or privacy rule only in prose, not enforced at the tool boundary
classes.rootCause: CLAUDE.md rules (kill by own PID, never force-push, no gh api, no home paths, stay in the repo, measure on CI) were read by the model but not compiled into deny rules or hooks; each was enforced only after an incident.

hardening.enforcedBy: Lean generates settings deny/ask entries and the hook table; golden = every violating command found in this retro must be denied, every false positive allowed

mistakes.title: nav port: border colour and font-family wrong (no Lean source for these values)
mistakes.symptom: Every nav cell failed: border rgb(23,23,23) vs black, font-family missing on earn and lang switch.
mistakes.rootCause: Static CSS was restated by hand; Nav.lean models motion and hit test only (its one colour mention is a timing curve), so no check compared the copied value.
mistakes.detectedBy: integrate-ports full gate, about 3 h after the port handed back green
mistakes.leanReason: A static value equal to a Lean-emitted constant is a pure equality; generate the CSS constant and the gate value cannot drift.

mistakes.title: commission port: section/track heights, display and margins wrong
mistakes.symptom: Heights 829.77 vs 777.44, runway 0 vs 54, title display block vs flex.
mistakes.rootCause: Commission.lean models bands and runway (0.06 vh) but not section heights or static display/margin values; the port's local check used 13 Chrome probes.
mistakes.leanReason: Static values and the height formula are provable at every breakpoint; the laid-out height is engine output.
mistakes.empiricalCheck: breakpoint gate on both engines, all widths

mistakes.title: pain.notes stage x bound to the wrong container
mistakes.symptom: notes x off; found only on CI.
mistakes.rootCause: The model premise was transcribed wrong (stage bound to .pain-notes-stage, original binds .pain-canvas); Lean then proved properties of the wrong binding.
mistakes.leanReason: Lean cannot know which DOM node the original binds; an anchor map generated from the snapshot plus a Lean check that the model names that anchor would catch it.

mistakes.title: platform.stageBg 32 px short on WebKit (aspect-ratio under grid stretch)
mistakes.symptom: stage h 319.6 vs 351.8 at 401-481 px, WebKit only.
mistakes.rootCause: Out of model scope: PlatformSection.lean states the aspect ratio but not how WebKit resolves it under grid stretch.
mistakes.leanReason: An Engine.WebKit lemma derived from the layout source could state the difference; the truth is WebKit's layout code.
mistakes.empiricalCheck: WebKit gate cells 401-481 px plus a pinned WebKit source read

mistakes.title: TS pilot parts unfaithful in 5 places; 3 inventory errors
mistakes.symptom: An independent Lean reading of the original disagreed with the TS in 5 places.
mistakes.rootCause: Ports hand-written from the original with no golden vectors.
mistakes.detectedBy: Lean (lean-parts) - the Lean-first rule worked here
mistakes.leanReason: TS checked against Lean goldens is exactly the fix.

mistakes.title: morph.columns rendered before platform; panel-at-rest stand-ins and platform min width missing
mistakes.symptom: Wrong page order and rest state found by debug gate runs.
mistakes.rootCause: Page order and rest state lived in no spec; each port chose its own.
mistakes.leanReason: Page order is a list and rest state a value; generate both from Lean.

mistakes.title: Golden files with no staleness check (exporter vs committed golden)
mistakes.symptom: Agents reported no regenerate script and no staleness check in lake test.
mistakes.rootCause: Task write sets excluded lean/scripts and the test driver, so regen-and-diff was deferred.
mistakes.cost: TS possibly checked against stale vectors
mistakes.leanReason: gen() = committed is a decidable equality run in lake test.

mistakes.title: Lean proofs did not catch the port CSS failures (umbrella)
mistakes.symptom: Integrated ports failed 64 Chromium and 88 WebKit cells while every part had Lean proofs.
mistakes.rootCause: No coverage map from gate probe to Lean value: many probed properties had no model, goldens covered logic.ts only, and models were copied by hand.
mistakes.leanReason: A coverage map (probe -> Lean source or exemption) is a finite decidable relation.

mistakes.title: PLAN, explainer page and notes drifted; published page left at rev 5 while repo was at rev 8
mistakes.symptom: Page showed decided questions as open, stale counts; user read the old page.
mistakes.rootCause: Hand-synced copies of the same decisions; no generation or staleness hash.
mistakes.cost: review rounds; user read stale content
mistakes.leanReason: A staleness hash (page embeds hash of the PLAN sections it renders) is provable; content correctness is review.

mistakes.title: Docstring math drifted from Lean in every review round (r3..r13)
mistakes.symptom: Disagree rows: r3 54, r4 71, r5 62, r8 49, r13 72; ~13 fix agents.
mistakes.rootCause: LaTeX written from intuition after the proof; lints added one per round.
mistakes.detectedBy: math review rounds, hours after commit
mistakes.leanReason: Free/bound variable coverage is decidable on parsed TeX vs Lean binders; semantic faithfulness needs a reviewer.

mistakes.title: Set-builder counts where Lean takes list-filter lengths; injectivity for Nodup
mistakes.symptom: Admit eq_of_nodup_map read as a tautology; msView counts duplicates differently.
mistakes.rootCause: List vs set semantics not represented in the TeX convention.
mistakes.leanReason: A lint flags |{...}| over a List-typed binder; whether the prose intends multiset is review.

mistakes.title: Bound variables shadowed functions in the math
mistakes.rootCause: No shadow lint until f7962c5.
mistakes.leanReason: Name collision between bound and free identifiers is syntactic (ShadowLint now does it).

mistakes.title: Math fixes introduced new math errors (doubled backslash dropped a forall; row break)
mistakes.symptom: Admit.Inv lost its quantifier; Serve.touched where-clause broke.
mistakes.rootCause: Fixes not rendered or linted before commit.
mistakes.leanReason: A TeX parse plus binder coverage on the changed docstring rejects a dropped quantifier.

mistakes.title: Where-clauses placed after the $$ block (64 hits)
mistakes.symptom: Definitions outside the math went unread.
mistakes.rootCause: No position rule for where-clauses until WhereLint.
mistakes.leanReason: Position of a where-clause relative to $$ is syntactic.

mistakes.title: Docstrings state only a count; renames leave stale math
mistakes.symptom: |crTypes|=8 only; RunTable named Run; pilotParts lists 6 of 14.
mistakes.rootCause: No rule that the math determines the definition; renames do not touch docstrings.
mistakes.leanReason: Identifier staleness (math names a constant that no longer exists) is decidable; "math determines the definition" is not.

mistakes.title: English prose overclaims beyond the proved theorems
mistakes.symptom: "probability exactly 1/70" without its premise; "no starvation" overclaimed.
mistakes.rootCause: Prose written ahead of the theorem; no rule that a claim cites a theorem.
mistakes.leanReason: A lint can require each claim sentence to name a theorem; whether the theorem supports it is review.

mistakes.title: Review staleness missed docstring-only edits; latest review chosen by file name
mistakes.symptom: Docstring-only edits kept old reviews valid.
mistakes.rootCause: stmtHash covered the statement only; ordering relied on naming.
mistakes.leanReason: mathHash of the normalised docstring plus a round: field is a pure key (now MathView.lean:169).

mistakes.title: PLAN aging bound was false (item queued at t=25 vs claimed 20)
mistakes.rootCause: Bound stated in prose without proof.
mistakes.leanReason: Bounds are theorems; the proved one is (1+Psi) dmax.

mistakes.title: Claim of 0 UpdateLayoutTree for compositor animations
mistakes.symptom: One main-thread style update per frame remains.
mistakes.rootCause: Claim stated before measured or read in source.
mistakes.leanReason: An Engine.Chromium lemma from source could state it; truth is the trace.

mistakes.title: Plan assumed per-part Chromium counts
mistakes.symptom: Counts exist only per frame and per scroll zone.
mistakes.rootCause: Trace data shape not checked before planning.
mistakes.leanReason: Depends on what the external trace format provides.
mistakes.empiricalCheck: read one real CI trace before planning a metric

mistakes.title: Assumed an iOS 26.6 runtime exists; xcodes 2.0.2 crashed
mistakes.symptom: Runtime install failed; phone upgraded to 27.0.1.
mistakes.rootCause: Availability not listed before planning.
mistakes.leanReason: External service catalogue.
mistakes.empiricalCheck: list available runtimes before planning an install

mistakes.title: PLAN rev 7 marked WKTR on macos-26 CONFIRMED before any run; wrong runner for the sim lane
mistakes.symptom: CONFIRMED with nothing run; lane named macos-26 while it runs on xcode-27.
mistakes.rootCause: Status taken from the archive SDK; workflow file not read.
mistakes.leanReason: A claim lint would refuse CONFIRMED without a run id or file:line; whether the citation supports it is review.

mistakes.title: README: no prebuilt iOS WKTR exists; renderingUpdate is one update
mistakes.rootCause: Claims not checked against WebKit CI steps or ui-helper.js.
mistakes.leanReason: Claim lint requires src@sha; the reading is empirical.

mistakes.title: Plan assumptions refuted by the feasibility review (BeginFrameControl on macOS, page.clock, gh api -f, Lean panic default)
mistakes.rootCause: Plan written before reading engine source and tool defaults.
mistakes.leanReason: Claim lint forces a citation; the source reading itself is empirical.

mistakes.title: Note said the CI lane disables threaded animation; it does not
mistakes.rootCause: Inferred from a flag name, did not read run.mjs.
mistakes.leanReason: If the lane's switch list is Lean data (generated into run.mjs), the claim is a lookup.

mistakes.title: Hand-picked golden vector with a tie made the "better" example not better
mistakes.rootCause: Example chosen by hand, tie unhandled.
mistakes.leanReason: Goldens computed by #eval of the Lean verdict cannot disagree with it.

mistakes.title: Profiler misattributed stalls (Mac sleep), build share (3% vs 12%) and Edit latency
mistakes.rootCause: Tool time taken from the first block of multi-tool messages; caffeinate renewed with gaps.
mistakes.leanReason: The attribution rule over transcript events is a pure function and provable; sleep needs pmset logs.

mistakes.title: load1 read as CPU overload
mistakes.symptom: load1 412 with 64% idle reported as oversubscribed.
mistakes.rootCause: On macOS load1 is not CPU demand.
mistakes.leanReason: OS metric semantics.

mistakes.title: Rate-limit diagnosis flip-flopped (two tokens involved)
mistakes.symptom: Told the user twice, then corrected.
mistakes.rootCause: Concluded from one token's numbers without checking which token agents used.
mistakes.cost: wrong claim to the user twice
mistakes.leanReason: External service and credentials.
mistakes.empiricalCheck: identify the token in use (gh auth status) before quoting its budget

mistakes.title: sim-speed note: 11 review issues, CONFIRMED cause without code
mistakes.symptom: Recommendation already default; before numbers not reproducible.
mistakes.rootCause: Comparisons not like-for-like; status not earned.
mistakes.leanReason: Claim lint catches the missing citation; like-for-like is empirical.
mistakes.empiricalCheck: paired runs on the same runner

mistakes.title: Upstream pins did not match published packages (Emotion); clones not on lock sha
mistakes.symptom: Source read could be the wrong code.
mistakes.rootCause: Monorepo pinned by one commit instead of per-package release tags.
mistakes.leanReason: HEAD == lock sha is decidable; package->tag mapping is external.
mistakes.empiricalCheck: compare published tarball to pinned source

mistakes.title: gate --parts filter task saved nothing (528 vs 536 s)
mistakes.symptom: Every probe applied to every part.
mistakes.rootCause: Saving expected without a cost model of the probe matrix.
mistakes.leanReason: A theorem on scopeProbes shows the matrix shrinks only if probes are part-scoped.

mistakes.title: Roadmap planned as calendar days, not an ASAP dependency graph
mistakes.rootCause: Plan section copied from v1 style; no lint against dates.
mistakes.leanReason: A lint forbidding dates in tasks is decidable; intent is human.

mistakes.title: Console decision logic written in TS before the Lean core existed
mistakes.symptom: User: why not Lean for provable?
mistakes.rootCause: Builder spawned before its Lean dependency; graph had no edge.
mistakes.leanReason: "decides => depends on a Lean task" is a graph lint once tasks carry a kind label; the label is human.

mistakes.title: Gap harness judged Q33 with the retired TS verdict
mistakes.rootCause: Old JS verdict path reused; Lean-first not enforced on harnesses.
mistakes.leanReason: An import lint (verdict functions only from fwcore ops) is decidable.

mistakes.title: Every-breakpoint parity missing from the plan
mistakes.rootCause: Requirements not derived from the original CSS/JS.
mistakes.leanReason: Once stated, BreakpointMatrix enforces it; the omission was human.

mistakes.title: Device measurement planned as primary evidence; user redirected twice
mistakes.symptom: Phone sessions kept as main evidence; rev 10 replaced with proofs.
mistakes.rootCause: Evidence model chosen before the principle was stated.
mistakes.leanReason: A plan lint can require verdict kind = proof per optimisation; choosing the principle is human.

mistakes.title: Upstream source store planned but never scheduled
mistakes.rootCause: PLAN item with no task.
mistakes.leanReason: PLAN item -> task coverage is a finite map.

mistakes.title: Critical-path blockers not prioritised until the user named them
mistakes.rootCause: Ready tasks pulled without ranking.
mistakes.leanReason: criticalPath_longest exists; ranking ready by it is a pure sort.

mistakes.title: Breakpoint-gate summary exits 0 while parts fail (still open)
mistakes.symptom: Job green while nav failed every cell.
mistakes.rootCause: cli.mjs summary path has no non-zero exit; merge job fails only on shape errors.
mistakes.cost: port-nav sat ~1.5 h; bugs found late
mistakes.leanReason: exit = 0 iff Lean rollup = pass is a pure function of summary.json.

mistakes.title: Port agents reported pass from job conclusions
mistakes.rootCause: Green conclusions read as verdict; "did not read the merge verdict file".
mistakes.leanReason: Handback requires a verdict record whose rollup = pass.

mistakes.title: Scoped local debug gates reported as pass
mistakes.rootCause: Verdict record had no scope; local scoped run read as full.
mistakes.leanReason: A verdict carries scope; handback requires scope = full on CI.

mistakes.title: Variant gate runs tested flags off; morph.mount:shift landed on that pass
mistakes.symptom: Runs 39067215069, 39067391933 passed with no flag on.
mistakes.rootCause: workflow_dispatch had no flag input; nobody checked which flags ran.
mistakes.leanReason: flags(run) = flags(task) is a pure equality in the verdict record.

mistakes.title: console-lean landed with a failing crash test
mistakes.rootCause: Land command merged unconditionally.
mistakes.leanReason: land_commit_exact: merge only when checks pass (fw land now).

mistakes.title: Lean build falsely green after a conflict merge
mistakes.symptom: Scope.lean not rebuilt; more conflicts than shown.
mistakes.rootCause: Conflict check relied on an incremental build.
mistakes.leanReason: No conflict markers and full rebuild of touched modules is decidable; Lake staleness is the tool's.

mistakes.title: Agents handed back with no verdict-bearing run (header differs uninvestigated, runs cancelled, head not pushed)
mistakes.rootCause: No completion gate.
mistakes.leanReason: Handback requires a verdict at branch head.

mistakes.title: Code merges landed without review
mistakes.symptom: Only PLAN and math got adversarial review.
mistakes.rootCause: No review stage in the land path.
mistakes.leanReason: A land rule requiring a review record is decidable; review quality is human.

mistakes.title: Gate sampled unsettled pages; fix agents chased non-bugs (pain.notes, hero.orbit, overlays.signup, people.card filter tail)
mistakes.symptom: fix-misc fixed 0 of 4 cells; all gate timing.
mistakes.rootCause: No settled-sample predicate (animations running, < 2 rAF after resize, pointer on hover target).
mistakes.leanReason: Settledness of a recorded sample is a pure predicate (gate-settle); whether the engine settled is I/O.

mistakes.title: Mounting lazy parts before collection made scroll-driven values lag
mistakes.rootCause: Prepare scrolled the original and back; collect read stale state.
mistakes.leanReason: Collect-after-settle ordering is provable as a step order; lag is engine.

mistakes.title: Shard merge refused: "header differs" between shards
mistakes.rootCause: Property list from one timed scan per shard.
mistakes.leanReason: Header as a function of scope only (Lean ScopeGen) is identical across shards by construction.

mistakes.title: measure.freeze accepted a 403-frame job beside 409
mistakes.rootCause: Freeze spec had no equal-frames precondition.
mistakes.leanReason: framesRefusal (now Freeze.lean:867).

mistakes.title: WebKit A vs R steps compared by index though page heights differ
mistakes.rootCause: Index assumed equal to scroll position.
mistakes.leanReason: Pair by offset is a pure function with a theorem.

mistakes.title: step-align merge crashed: one VM had an extra step
mistakes.rootCause: Merge assumed identical step sets.
mistakes.leanReason: aligned_iff exists; merge refuses naming the VM.

mistakes.title: Chromium touchmove race made counts non-deterministic
mistakes.rootCause: Blink 200 ms async-touchmove hold not awaited.
mistakes.leanReason: Engine timing.

mistakes.title: Chromium touch wedge: WaitForLateScrollEvents timer at virtual time
mistakes.rootCause: Timer ~4900 s ahead of the container clock.
mistakes.leanReason: Engine internals under virtual time.
mistakes.empiricalCheck: wedge count over CI jobs (0 in 9, b9bb373)

mistakes.title: Clock shim faked performance.now but left document.timeline native
mistakes.rootCause: Shim covered some time sources only.
mistakes.leanReason: "Every time source reads the virtual clock" is a statable invariant over a source list; coverage of the shim is I/O.

mistakes.title: BeginFrame harness errors (frame pending, Network.enable hang, TDZ)
mistakes.rootCause: Protocol ordering rules not modelled.
mistakes.leanReason: CDP protocol behaviour.

mistakes.title: HitTest and N1 counts polluted by unrelated engine work
mistakes.symptom: Overlay-ad detector inside HitTest; SVG-image docs in N1.
mistakes.rootCause: Events aggregated by name without containment split.
mistakes.leanReason: Split by parent event is pure once the trace tree is given.

mistakes.title: Pixel-area census types quarantined by count tolerance tMax = 24
mistakes.rootCause: One tolerance rule for counts and pixel areas (unit mismatch).
mistakes.leanReason: Tolerance indexed by unit type makes the mismatch a type error.

mistakes.title: WKTR lane drift from the page clock: 202 min to find it unfit as a gate
mistakes.rootCause: Page clock and CSS animations not frozen before planning a gate lane.
mistakes.leanReason: Harness/engine timing.
mistakes.empiricalCheck: repeatability runs before calling a lane a gate

mistakes.title: webkit-sim lane still failing after 207 min and 4 pushes
mistakes.symptom: Session stalls on loaded runner; rows joined by index.
mistakes.rootCause: Mac-tuned sleeps; index join.
mistakes.leanReason: Row join by key is provable; stalls are runner load.

mistakes.title: Chromium gate hung at >= 1000 px in the arm64 container
mistakes.rootCause: Root cause unknown; no fast-fail.
mistakes.leanReason: Environment-specific hang.

mistakes.title: Load-sensitive tests flaked (hook <100 ms, runner test)
mistakes.rootCause: Wall-clock thresholds.
mistakes.leanReason: Timing.
mistakes.empiricalCheck: run tests under synthetic load; no wall-clock thresholds

mistakes.title: console-api crash test race (exit vs EPIPE)
mistakes.rootCause: Restart accounting depended on event order.
mistakes.leanReason: Order-independent crash accounting is a commutation theorem; OS ordering is empirical.

mistakes.title: Lead commit on main during fw land became the merge commit
mistakes.symptom: Commit without Task trailer; checks re-run.
mistakes.rootCause: Land held merge --no-commit open with no lock.
mistakes.leanReason: Land lock protocol: run_safe_locked, land_commit_exact (done).

mistakes.title: Every parallel branch conflicted on lean/Fw.lean and registration files
mistakes.rootCause: Hand-kept import list and registries.
mistakes.leanReason: Generated import list; check-imports (done).

mistakes.title: Ports diverged: four prepare paths, ~10 conflicting shared files
mistakes.symptom: Ports could not land one by one.
mistakes.rootCause: Shared gate machinery not factored before fan-out.
mistakes.leanReason: "Tasks writing a shared module depend on one owner task" is a graph lint; the factoring choice is design.

mistakes.title: Semantic conflict: zone-baseline read the old classes.frozen.json schema
mistakes.rootCause: Producer and consumer changed in parallel; no shared schema type.
mistakes.leanReason: Producer/consumer from one Lean Wire type plus read-set admission.

mistakes.title: Merge-order skew broke tests and guards (capMac arity, OpsWire, mutant guards)
mistakes.rootCause: Branches built on an older main; checks per branch alone.
mistakes.leanReason: Land re-checks on the merged tree; admission sees signature reads.

mistakes.title: Parallel builds: lean-serve removed state con-land read
mistakes.rootCause: Hidden read dependency.
mistakes.leanReason: Read sets in admission.

mistakes.title: Four fix agents each merged the unlanded integration branch and hit the same conflict
mistakes.rootCause: Fan-out from an unlanded, stale branch.
mistakes.leanReason: waitDeps: fan-out only after the dependency is landed (Obs.Next waitDeps_sound).

mistakes.title: Worktree creation race on parallel spawns
mistakes.rootCause: Concurrent git worktree add.
mistakes.leanReason: git and platform internals.

mistakes.title: Edits raced with concurrent writers ("modified since read")
mistakes.rootCause: Generator or parallel edit in the same tree.
mistakes.leanReason: Single-writer per path is admission; generator timing is I/O.

mistakes.title: pub-prep wrote duplicate files into the main checkout
mistakes.rootCause: Absolute main paths from a worktree agent.
mistakes.leanReason: PathCheck: writes inside own worktree.

mistakes.title: Lead cd into a worktree moved the session cwd; spawned agent inherited it
mistakes.symptom: page-rev5 started in a stale tree.
mistakes.rootCause: Session cwd persists across cd.
mistakes.leanReason: A hook refusing a lead cd into .claude/worktrees is a pure decision; cwd inheritance is platform.
